export const CONTRACT_NAME = "__CONTRACT_NAME__" as const;
export const CONTRACT_VERSION = "__CONTRACT_VERSION__" as const;
export const CONTRACT_OWNER = "__CONTRACT_OWNER__" as const;
export const CONTRACT_CLIENT_WORKLOAD = "__CONTRACT_CLIENT_WORKLOAD__" as const;
export const CONTRACT_SOURCE_DIGEST = "__CONTRACT_SOURCE_DIGEST__" as const;

export const ERROR_CODES = __ERROR_CODES__ as const;
export type ContractErrorCode = (typeof ERROR_CODES)[number];

export type DataClassification =
  | "public"
  | "internal"
  | "confidential"
  | "restricted";

export interface SafeContractError {
  code: ContractErrorCode;
  message: string;
  correlationId: string;
  retryable: boolean;
  retryAfterMs?: number;
}

export class ContractError extends Error implements SafeContractError {
  readonly name = "ContractError";

  constructor(
    readonly code: ContractErrorCode,
    message: string,
    readonly correlationId: string,
    readonly retryable: boolean,
    readonly retryAfterMs?: number,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

export interface ContractProbeInput {
  operationId: string;
  correlationId: string;
  idempotencyKey: string;
  deadlineAt: string;
  payload: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface ContractProbeResponse {
  requestId: string;
  operationId: string;
  correlationId: string;
  classification: DataClassification;
  acceptedAt: string;
  replayed: boolean;
}

/** Internal-only envelope created by Gateway after client admission. */
export interface GatewayContractProbeRequest extends ContractProbeInput {
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ContractProbeOwnerHandler {
  submitAcceptedContractProbe(
    input: GatewayContractProbeRequest,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<ContractProbeResponse>;
}

export interface ContractProbeTransport {
  submitContractProbe(
    input: ContractProbeInput,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<ContractProbeResponse>;
}

export class LensContractClient {
  constructor(private readonly transport: ContractProbeTransport) {}

  submitContractProbe(
    input: ContractProbeInput,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<ContractProbeResponse> {
    return this.transport.submitContractProbe(input, signal);
  }
}
